en: A monochrome vintage image showing a calm river curving through a rural landscape. On the left bank stand several two‑storey houses with steep roofs and simple facades, followed further back by more small buildings partly obscured by dense trees. A forested hill rises behind the settlement, and a flagpole with a faint flag can be seen near the central building complex. On the right side of the river a small boat with a few people is visible. The overall style and tonality suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard of a small European riverside town.
